_note: Task tunables for build_tower (r0B_lean). Values are geometric choices or probe depth measurements (head depth: cube top - table = 0.038 m, boards 0.020 m thick, long board 0.374 m, short board 0.244 m); none come from demos.

lean._wedge_note: wedge_ridge_across: native check aligns wedge x with short-board x; both start near identity yaw with ridge along world y and board long axis along world x, so the ridge is kept perpendicular to the board (inference from initial head-depth yaw, unverified).
lean._parallel_note: r2R_robust_np: pillars and top cubes placed by both arms simultaneously (one shared survey/verify); falls back to sequential per side. top_pair_long_grasp: in the top-cube pair close bricks across the long side so the open fingers spread across the board, not toward the other hand (it1 screen: short-side pairs left 6-10 mm release error, long-side 0.1 mm).
